## Diagnostics

Include minimal, manually redacted logs. Remove credentials, hostnames, personal paths, agent IDs and conversation content. Do not attach bindings, account files or capture bundles. Use SECURITY.md for vulnerabilities.

For an unknown result, preserve the existing operation and check its status; do not create another handoff just to reproduce the problem.
